（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
（批：E. G. S.
247
10/4/26）
Shanghai Municipal Council.
April 9th 1916.

Sir,
Owing to a report that the rebels would attack
the Arsenal on the night of the 8th instant,
extraordinary precautions were taken.
It is reported that the rebeld intend to attack
the Arsenal to night. So far, the only arms the
rebels have got are bombs and pistols.
A rebel named Zie Fong Ding was arrested in
the 3rd district in Chapei on 8th instant. A mauser
rifle, 400 rounds of ammunition and a rebel flag
were found in his home.
Five hundred troops arrived by train from
Nanking at Tsung Z E Z. at 4 a.m. 9th instant.
It is reported that on 7th instant some soldiers
at the Arsenal who were employed loading a transport
ship had some trouble with an officer, as a result
of which one of the former stabbed the latter in
the thigh with a bayonet.
A man was arrested in the Sicawei village
at 11.30 p.m. who was said to have a bomb and
a pistol in his possession. He was one of a band
of four, three of whom escaped. D.S.Sullivan
is making enquiries at the Station and will report
the information which he obtains.

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
（批：Entered on M.S. Apl 9. fr. 194）

警务处，
（侦探股。）
（批注：E. G. S.
247
1926年4月10日）

上海工部局。
1916年4月9日。

先生：

鉴于有报告称叛乱分子将于本月8日晚袭击兵工厂，已采取特别防范措施。

据报，叛乱分子意图于今晚袭击兵工厂。截至目前，叛乱分子所获武器仅有炸弹和手枪。

一名名为 Zie Fong Ding 的叛乱分子于本月8日在闸北第三区被捕。在其家中搜出一支毛瑟步枪、400发子弹及一面叛乱旗帜。

五百名士兵于本月9日凌晨4时乘火车从南京抵达 Tsung Z E Z（音译）。

据报，本月7日，兵工厂内一些负责装载运输船的士兵与一名军官发生纠纷，结果其中一名士兵用刺刀刺伤了该军官的大腿。

晚上11时30分，一名男子在徐家汇村被捕，据说其持有炸弹和手枪。此人为一个四人团伙的成员，其中三人逃脱。侦探警佐沙利文（D.S. Sullivan）正在警局进行调查，并将报告其所获情报。

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
总探长。

警察总监上尉。
（批注：录入于 M.S. 4月9日。来自 194）
